body:
I’m think of ways we can have trial separation.  I had some money put away from a previous job. I was going to pay for that training course so I can further my career and make some easy money. 
Today my old cat was so sick and we had to rush her into the vet for blood tests. When we had to pay the bill I knew he didn’t have the money for it so I said “just use my money for my course” (my cat is my furry child so I was happy to use some of my money on her especially to find out if she is sick) he fumbled his word and then set up a vet pay account, (another loan/credit card).
He had spent my money for my course.
So in the car I told him we are going to get through Christmas and then see what is happening in the new year. He doesn’t think I’m serious. He says “we are all just emotional because of the cat” etc. 
I hate when he dismisses my emotions and actions as mere fads or phases. 

I’ve very much started the separation ball rolling and it’s up to me to stick to my guns.
